sources.citation: game-design: a plain two-tip screwdriver of the kind every electrician carries (tip forms per ISO 8764 and ISO 2380, cited by number). It drives a terminal screw but has no torque setting, so the torque it applies is a seeded spread around the terminal's marked value (plan D8, ADR 0015), and it opens knockouts, pryouts and box clamps (the ENTRY_TYPES registry). No size limit: driving a screw doesn't depend on the conductor.
